metric: Correlation of PPG-derived RR intervals with ECG reference, and correlation of a PPG-based ML stress model's score with a validated stress questionnaire (DASS-21-C)
result: PPG-ECG RR interval correlation r=0.9920, R2=0.9837; ML stress model baseline score vs DASS-21-C stress score correlation r=0.92, R2=0.8457

error_rate: MAPE 2.39-3.30% (Cocoron) vs 2.26-5.82% (Apple Watch 7) across supine/seated/walking positions
metric: Heart rate measurement accuracy of a telemetric single-lead ECG transmitter and Apple Watch 7 versus an RF-ECG reference, across postures
result: MAPE of 2.39%/3.30%/3.27% (Cocoron) vs 2.26%/3.71%/5.82% (Apple Watch 7) for supine/seated/walking; Cocoron significantly more accurate overall (p=0.013); Apple Watch showed larger error and wider limits of agreement during ambulation (upper LOA 12.02), attributed to PPG motion artifact

metric: Diagnostic accuracy of GPT-4o versus the Apple Watch's built-in algorithm for classifying atrial fibrillation from single-lead smartwatch ECG
result: Apple Watch algorithm: 97.3% accuracy for AF and 100% for sinus rhythm; GPT-4o correctly classified 47.3% of AF and 71.6% of sinus rhythm tracings, across 114 AF patients and 60 controls

metric: Systematic review of objective neurophysiological methods (ECG, EEG, eye data) for assessing mental workload in real-world professional settings
result: 35 studies included, showing a diversity of measurement tools often combined with subjective assessments; no unified measurement framework identified

metric: Effect of a complex, dynamically changing environment on cognitive load, affective state, performance, and physiological stress (fNIRS, EEG, ECG, EDA)
result: Abstract text truncated; effect on cognitive load, affective state, and performance reported, but not on physiological stress (specific values not available in this excerpt)

metric: Machine-learning (HMM) evaluation of pilot mental workload from ECG signal indexes and NASA-TLX scale in a low-visibility flight simulator
result: Average heart rate and workload scale scores rose significantly in low-visibility conditions; pNN20, HF/LF, SD2/SD1, and HR discriminated workload levels; HMM-based model reached up to 87.5% accuracy, across 40 pilots

error_rate: HR average difference of 1-2 bpm vs reference ECG; HRV and EDA agreement insufficient by Bland-Altman ratio analysis
metric: Criterion validity of the EmotiBit PPG wearable versus a reference ECG device for heart rate (HR), HRV, and electrodermal activity during cognitive workload
result: Good agreement for HR (average difference 1-2 bpm); insufficient agreement for HRV and EDA measures compared to the reference ECG device, across 15 participants

metric: Survey of telemedicine acceptance, use frequency, and attitudes among cardiologists, internists, and general practitioners in cardiology care
result: 112 of 929 contacted physicians (12.1%) completed the survey; 43% never use telemedicine, 16% use it daily; 77.7% wanted to expand telemedicine use; clinical caseload differed significantly across attitude clusters (C1 vs C2 p=.03, C1 vs C3 p=.02, C2 vs C3 p<.001)

Narrative overview of digitalization in cardiovascular emergencies: prehospital digital ECG transmission, guideline/decision-support apps, and AI for image analysis and risk prediction, with regulatory and data-protection barriers discussed; no primary data reported

metric: Detection performance and power/space trade-offs of a batteryless analog folded neural network for ECG-based screening
result: A favorable accuracy trade-off was found around 6 layers and a hidden size of 30; feasibility of batteryless wearable implementation demonstrated (no specific accuracy percentage reported)

task_time: DL model generated results within 30 seconds via a guided user interface
metric: Diagnostic accuracy of a deep-learning model for interpreting SPECT wall motion versus human readers and quantitative parameters (echocardiography as reference)
result: AUC 0.82 (DL) vs 0.77 (human, p<.001) vs 0.74 (quantitative parameters, p<.05); accuracy 0.88 (DL) vs 0.82 (human) vs 0.78 (quantitative); net reclassification index 7.7%, across 1038 patients

metric: Feasibility of a 3D microfiber E-textile electrode system for ECG/EMG signal acquisition during exercise and clinical maternal monitoring
result: System demonstrated low electrode-skin impedance without gel, waterproofing, and real-time multimodal ECG/EMG monitoring during cycling, swimming, and a clinical maternal ECG/EMG study (no comparative accuracy or usability numbers reported)

Study protocol (not yet reporting results) for evaluating a smartphone app for prehospital ECG transmission and STEMI catheterization-lab activation; planned outcomes include usability, acceptability, treatment-time intervals, and false-activation rates

metric: Clinician-rated clinical relevance and helpfulness of deep-learning saliency maps for occlusion myocardial infarction (OMI) identification from ECG, and diagnostic accuracy of clinicians versus the DL model
result: Clinicians' adjudicated AUC 0.855 vs DL model AUC 0.872 (F1 0.789 vs 0.747); saliency maps rated slightly clinically relevant (0.96 +/- 0.92) and slightly helpful (0.66 +/- 0.98) on a -3 to +3 Likert scale; clinician confidence in model predictions 1.71 +/- 0.56, across 100 ECGs reviewed by 3 clinicians
